BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS: BSC.   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: MLT   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: BMT417 INDIAN CONSTITUTIONS
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Constitution is the supreme law of India comment on it ? [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) What is preamble? What are the components of the preamble of our constitution? [3] 1 2


Q.2(a) Who is known  as the Father of INDIAN  CONSTITUTION  ? [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Explain Fundamental Rights  in a brief manner? [3] 1 1


Q.3(a) Define citizenship? What are the methods of acquiring Indian citizenship? [2] 2 2
Q.3(b) Analyse and explain the duties of a citizen as per Indian constitution? [3] 2 2


Q.4(a) Explain Directive Principles  of   State Policy  in a brief manner? [2] 2 2
Q.4(b) Describe the functions and powers of Prime Minister of India? [3] 2 2


Q.5(a) Describe the functions and power of a  lok Sabha? [2] 2 2
Q.5(b) Describe the functions and power of a  Chief Minister? [3]
